name: PvP & View
description: Zoom, toggle sprint and sneak, your own crosshair, block outline and hit colour, lower fire and shield. Nothing beyond what vanilla allows.

setting.zoom.desc: Hold the zoom key to look closer, like a spyglass.
setting.toggleSprint.desc: Press the sprint key once to keep sprinting, again to stop.
setting.toggleSneak.desc: Press the sneak key once to keep sneaking, again to stop.
setting.showToggleState.desc: A small "Sprinting (toggled)" note on the HUD.
setting.outline.desc: Colour and thickness of the frame around the block you look at.
setting.hitColor.desc: The colour mobs and players flash when they get hurt.
setting.lowFire.desc: The flames in front of your eyes sit lower when you burn.
setting.lowShield.desc: Your shield is held lower in first person, so you see more.
setting.zoomSensitivity.desc: Mouse speed follows the zoom, so aiming feels the same.

hud.togglestate.desc: Shows when toggle sprint or sneak is on

editor.title: Crosshair
editor.hint: Changes show right away in the middle of the screen.
editor.moduleOff: PvP & View is switched off: the game shows the vanilla crosshair.
editor.vanilla: The normal Minecraft crosshair. Pick a shape to make your own.
